subject: EB liaison + evaluation runway: proposed MAP, eval plan & meeting slots
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@helixtherapeutics.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@helixtherapeutics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: EB liaison + evaluation runway: proposed MAP, eval plan & meeting slots

Hi Emily + Rajiv —

Per our conversation last week, attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and a one-page evaluation plan that aligns the technical POC, procurement milestones, and executive briefing (EB) checkpoints we discussed. Goal: get to signed order by mid-December with two EB touchpoints (alignment + executive sign-off).

High-level asks:
- Confirm availability for an EB alignment meeting week of Nov 30 — proposed 60-minute slot (we can tighten to 30).
- Confirm who from your executive bench will join the final EB sign-off (titles are fine).
- Let us know if procurement needs a separate kickoff; we can include Monica for contract/terms prep.

Key dates in the MAP (draft):
- 11/23–11/30: Technical eval window (Redwood provides test corpus and access)
- 11/30–12/03: EB alignment (review POC results + roadmap fit)
- 12/08: Executive sign-off EB (leadership + procurement present)
- 12/15: Target EEA/PO issuance

Attachments: 20261120-Helix-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet), 20261120-eval-plan-summary.pdf (evaluation checklist + success criteria).

If these dates look tight, say the word — we can compress the eval or move the final EB. Also internally looping Lauren to capture the EB attendee roster and Karthik for rollout/ops constraints.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: 20261120-Helix-MAP-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: 20261120-eval-plan-summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@helixtherapeutics.com>

Date: 2026-11-22T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EB liaison + evaluation runway: proposed MAP, eval plan & meeting slots

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick responses:
- EB alignment week of Nov 30 works for us; preference is Tue 12/01 10:30–11:30 PT or Wed 12/02 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Final sign-off will include: Emily Zhang (CFO), Rajiv Menon (CTO) and our Head of Data Ops (TBD). I will confirm the Data Ops name by EOD Nov 24.
- Procurement looped in here (procurement@helixtherapeutics.com). They asked if you can share standard SOW/TS and a high-level security addendum — happy to have Monica coordinate.

Also, on success criteria: can you add a short paragraph in the MAP clarifying what “pass” looks like for the POC? The eval plan is helpful but the EB wants a 2–3 line executive-friendly success statement.

Appreciate it — Emily
Emily Zhang | CFO, Helix Therapeutics
emily.zhang@helixtherapeutics.com | +1 617-555-0104

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:40:00-08:00
Subject: RE: EB liaison + evaluation runway: proposed MAP, eval plan & meeting slots

Looping internal owners for EB roster and SOW. Proposal for Redwood EB attendees: Rishi (AE), Lauren (Head of Sales Ops), Monica (Commercial Contracts). Karthik — can you confirm if Engineering should join the alignment meeting (12/01 or 12/02) to walk the POC results?

Also Rishi — I'll add the 2–3 line executive success statement to the MAP and re-attach. Draft language suggestion: “Redwood demonstrates >95% fidelity on the representative test corpus, average generation latency under 150ms at target batch sizes, and no PII leakage during the scoped evaluation window.” Will tailor if Helix prefers different thresholds.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: EB liaison + evaluation runway: proposed MAP, eval plan & meeting slots

Rishi / Monica —

Procurement here. Can you provide:
1) Standard MSA + SOW template for Redwood (redacted commercial terms ok)
2) Data processing addendum or summary of data handling / retention
3) A ballpark pricing cadence for Dedicated vs Hosted for the proposed 6-month ramp (numbers only, can be annotated as "budgetary").

We want those attached before the EB alignment meeting if possible so procurement can triage outstanding legal questions offline.

Thanks,
Helix Procurement
procurement@helixtherapeutics.com

Emily — thanks for the preferred times. We booked Tue 12/01 10:30–11:30 PT and sent a calendar invite (link below).

Per procurement's asks, attaching: redacted MSA + SOW template, a two-paragraph data handling summary, and a budgetary pricing sheet for Hosted vs Dedicated (6-month ramp). Monica will own any follow-ups on commercial terms.

I've also updated the MAP with Lauren's executive success statement and included explicit acceptance criteria for the POC (see MAP tab \"Exec Summary\"). Please find attachments: 20261120-Helix-MAP-draft.xlsx (updated), 20261120-eval-plan-summary.pdf, and new 20261201-eb-meeting-agenda.pdf.

Links: Calendar invite — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=helix-eb-20261201
HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HLX-2026-1387

Next steps for tomorrow's alignment:
- 10:30–10:45: POC results and live demo (Karthik or engineering rep)
- 10:45–11:05: Roadmap + integration plan (Rishi + Lauren)
- 11:05–11:25: Commercial & procurement Qs (Monica + Procurement)
- 11:25–11:30: Action items and final EB confirmation schedule

Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.

Rishi
